user_story: I want UI/UX execution to be handled by `ui-ux-dev` while Beacon governs accepted design results and version-level requirement projections,
So that Beacon remains a requirement governance kernel instead of a redundant design execution toolbox.
AC-001 Beacon stops treating internal UI/UX execution as a future core capability.
AC-002 Beacon routes UI/UX execution intent to `ui-ux-dev`.
AC-003 Beacon does not silently fallback to internal design generation when `ui-ux-dev` is unavailable.
AC-004 Beacon redefines `prototype` as a design-result adapter.
qa: | AC ID | Test ID | Layer | Command / Evidence | Assertion |
| AC-001 | TC-UXEXT-001 | contract | PRD/source review | Beacon marks internal UI/UX execution as non-core future capability |
| AC-002 | TC-UXEXT-002 | routing | skill routing evidence | UI/UX execution intent maps to `ui-ux-dev` intents |
| AC-003 | TC-UXEXT-003 | gate | missing upstream simulation | Missing `ui-ux-dev` routes to bootstrap, not silent internal fallback |
| AC-004 | TC-UXEXT-004 | contract | prototype skill / command review | `prototype` is adapter, not generator, in v1.4.9 contract |
| AC-005 | TC-UXEXT-005 | implement gate | accepted design result without binding | Implement blocks when adapter truth binding is missing |
| AC-006 | TC-UXEXT-006 | compatibility | historical prototype bundle fixture | Historical prototype remains readable but not v1.4.9 execution truth |

architecture: Beacon owns requirement truth、gate、adapter binding、evidence closure。
`prototype` owns accepted design result 的 requirement-facing adapter，不拥有设计生成。
`beacon-design-review` owns route / governance support，不拥有 UI/UX execution verdict。
version-level visualization owns human-readable projection，不拥有 canonical truth。
decision_priority: Beacon requirement truth 高于设计输出。
`ui-ux-dev` 负责 UI/UX execution，Beacon 负责 governance。
Accepted design result 必须进入 adapter binding，否则不能解锁 implementation。
Business flow / state-machine / map 是 projection，不是 canonical truth。
没有 truth bindings 的图不算 freeze-facing projection。
Historical prototype bundles 可兼容读取，但新版本不得继续把 Beacon 当设计生成器。
